overview: Studying Automobile Engineering - UG in Finland offers Indian students access to world-renowned Nordic education, innovative practical research, English-taught programmes, and excellent European career pathways.

faq.question: Can I study Automobile Engineering in Finland after 12th?
faq.answer: Yes. Students can pursue English-taught Bachelor

faq.question: Which university is suitable for Automobile Engineering-related studies in Finland?
faq.answer: LUT University offers an English-taught bachelor

faq.question: What is the tuition fee for Automobile Engineering-related studies in Finland?
faq.answer: Annual tuition fees range from €10,000 to €12,000 (around ₹10.86 lakh to ₹13.03 lakh). Eligible students at LUT can receive a €2,000 early-bird discount on the first-year fee, with €3,000 annual scholarships in subsequent years.

faq.question: Which subjects are important for Automobile Engineering?
faq.answer: Mathematics and Physics are the core Class 12 requirements. Knowledge of mechanics, electronics, and computer science provides an added advantage.
